newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat Eurokuna to be listed in Zagreb, Luxembourg.
newsitem.headline: Croat Eurokuna to be listed in Zagreb, Luxembourg.

text.p: Croatia said on Wednesday it hoped to list a maiden issue of 300 million kuna-denominated Eurobonds soon on Zagreb and Luxembourg stock exchanges.
"We have requested a listing and see no problem in getting it approved," Finance Minister Bozo Prka told Reuters.
He said the issue, which was fully underwritten, would probably be listed on January 8 next year.
Tomica Pustisek of Zagrebacka Banka said there was already strong demand for the bonds, each denominated at 10,000 kuna, aimed at attracting retail as well as institutional investors.
The bank led the domestic side of the issue, with Merrill Lynch in charge of the foreign placement.
Eurokuna yield a fixed 12.5 percent a year and they mature on December 18, 1998. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
